book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MADIU

content: Padahk duwen Mweipeseng en Pwopwoud
Kedekedeo, Sises lao ketin kaimwisekala mahsen pwukat, e ahpw ketiketla sang Kalili, ketin pwuralahng nan wehin Sudia, palio Pillap Sordan.
Lapalahn pokon ehu ahpw idawehnla; e ahpw ketin kakehleirailda wasao.
Parisi kei ahpw patohla rehn Sises oh song lidipiheki ar peidek ni ar kalelapak, “Ia duwe, atail Kosonnedo mweidohng ohl emen en mweisang eh pwoud pwehki kahrepe ieu sohte lipilipil?”
Sises ahpw ketin sapengkin irail, “Kumwail sohte kin wadek mahsen wet nan Pwuhk Sarawi duwen Sounwiepen aramas eh ketin wiahda ohl oh lih nin tapio?
Oh Koht mahsanih, ‘Iei kahrepen me ohl pahn mweikihsang seme oh ine oh patehng eh pwoud, oh ira riemen pahn wiahla warteieu.’
Ira eri solahr wia riemen, pwe warteieu. Eri, kaleke aramas de kamweidpeseng me Koht ketin kapatapenehr.”
Parisi ko ahpw kalelapak reh, “A dahme Moses koasoanehkihdi ohl en kihda kisinlikoun kamweid, e ahpw pahn kak mweisang eh pwoud?”
Sises ketin sapengkin irail, “Moses mweidohng kumwail en mweisang amwail pwoud kan pwehki amwail nohn keptakai. A sang nin tapio met sohte kin wiawi.
Eri, kumwail en ese pwe mehmen mweisang eh pwoud ni kahrepe ieu me kaidehn kamwahl, e ahpw pwoudikihda emen lih tohrohr, e wiadahr dipen kamwahl.”
Sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw patohwanohng, “Ma ih pahn duwen met, koasoandien nanpwungen ohl oh lih pwopwoud, me pahn mwahusang ma ieremen pwopwoudida.”
Sises ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Kaidehn koaros me kakohng ale padahk wet, pwe irailte me mweimweiong sang powe.

Pwe kahrepe kei mie me kahrehda aramas sohte kak pwopwoudida: rehn ekei, pwehki sang ni ar ipwidi paliwararail kan sohte unsek; rehn ekei, sang ni ar lekalahr paliwararail sohte unsek; a rehn ekei, sang ni pein nsenarail pwehki Wehin Koht re sohte kin men pwopwoud. Mehmen me kak ale padahk wet, a en ale.”
Sises ketin Kupwuramwahwih kisin Seri kei
Kisin seri kei ahpw wisikdohng rehn Sises pwe en ketikidahng pohrail lime kan oh kasakaskin irail. Tohnpadahko ko ahpw kidahwehda irail ko me patohwando seri ko.
Sises eri mahsanihong tohnpadahk ko, “Kumwail pweisang kisin seri kan, kumwail dehr keinepwihsang irail re en kohdo rehi, pwe Wehin Koht iei wehin soangen aramas pwukat.”
Ih eri ketikidahng pohrail lime ko, e ahpw ketiket sang wasao.
Mwahnakapw Kepwehpwe men
Rahn ehu mwahnakapw men ahpw patodohng rehn Sises oh patohwanohng, “Maing Sounpadahk, soangen wiewia mwahu da me I uhdahn pahn wia pwe I en alehki mour soutuk?”
A Sises ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Dahme ke idengki rehi duwen me mwahu? Mehtehmen me mwahu. Ma ke men kowohng nan mour soutuk, a kapwaiada kosonned akan.”
A e patohwanohng, “Mehnia?” A Sises ketin sapengki, “Dehr kemehla aramas; dehr kamwahl; dehr pirap; dehr karaun likamw;
kahkahki semomw oh inomw; poakohng mehn mpomw duwen omw kin poakohng pein uhk.”
Mwahnakapwo ahpw patohwanohng Sises, “Mepwukat koaros I kapwaiadahr. Dahme I en pil wia?”

Sises ketin mahsanihong, “Ma ke men unsekla mehlel, kohwei oh netikihla omw kepwe kan koaros, pweine kan ke ahpw kihong me semwehmwe kan, a e ahpw pahn mie omw pai nanleng; eri, ke ahpw kohdo iangiehla.”
Mwahnakapwo lao rong mahsen pwukat, e ahpw kapehd toutoula patopatohla sang wasao, pwe mwahnakapw kepwehpwe men ih.
Sises eri mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, “Kumwail en ese pwe me apwal mehlel ong aramas kepwehpwe men en pedolong nan Wehin Koht.
I pil men padahkihong kumwail duwen eh pahn apwal ong soangen aramaso en pedolong nan Wehin Koht, sang lapalahn mahn emen duwehte kamel, en dil nan pwoaren dikek ehu.”
Tohnpadahk ko lao rong met, re ahpw pwuriamweikihla mehlel, patopatohwan, “Eri a, ihs me pahn kak mourla ma ih pahn duwen met?”
Sises ketin sohpeilahng irail oh koamoleiraildi, mahsanih, “Met sohte kak pahn aramas, ahpw rehn Koht mehkoaros kak pweida.”
Piter eri patohwanohng, “Maing, iet kiht me keselahr at mehkoaros oh ideidawehn komwi; eri, dahme pahn pwaisat?”

Sises ketin mahsanih, “I men kumwail en ese pwe kumwail me ehk riemen me ideidawehn ie, kumwail pahn iang mwohd nan mwoalen kadeik oh iang kadeikada kadaudok eisek riaun Israel, ahnsou me Nein-Aramas pahn ket nan mwoale lingan nan sapwellime Mwei Kapw.
Oh irail koaros me tounmeteikilahr imwarail kan, riarail kan, samarail de inarail kan, de neirail seri kan, de sapwarail kan, pwehki ngehi, re pahn ale pak epwiki iangahki mour soutuk.
Eri, me tohto me kin mwowe ahnsou wet, re pahn ikmwurihla; a me tohto me kin mwuri ahnsou wet, re pahn mwowehla.”
